title: EternalTD
description: A full Tower Defense game in Minecraft servers!
body:
This dev log is the only video I have right now, a dedicated one will (hopefully) come soon!

# 🟠 Main Features * **Play a tower defense game in Minecraft!** * **Free tutorial and hub available for your convenience!** * **72 free custom models which you can use with [FreeMinecraftModels](https://nightbreak.io/plugin/freeminecraftmodels/)** to display these models in-game **for absolutely free!** * **5 free maps and 10 premium maps,** going from easy difficulty to hard! * **Create your own maps,** complete with levels, waves and models! **_Important_** _It is highly recommended that you install [FreeMinecraftModels](https://nightbreak.io/plugin/freeminecraftmodels/) and [ResourcePackManager](https://nightbreak.io/plugin/resourcepackmanager/) alongside EternalTD to see the models (but not mandatory)! You will have to download the free models from the free downloads listed below._ # 🟠 How to Setup 1. Put the EternalTD.jar into your server and restart your server 2. Download the content your want from the additional downloads and put it, without unzipping, into the ~plugins/EternalTD/imports folder 3. Do /etd reload or restart your server. Restarting is recommended. 4. If you are using FreeMinecraftModels with the official models (recommended), you can do /etd resourcepack install to immediately set your server to use the official EternalTD resource pack! 5. You're done! # 🟠 Additional downloads:

Click here for every free & premium download with more info!

# 🟠 Dependencies * [LibsDisguises](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/libs-disguises-free.81/) is recommended for disguising entities, but not required! * [WorldGuard](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldguard) or something similar is probably a good idea to protect the default hub. # 🟠 View More by Magmaguy!

# 🟠 Partner servers **Matecraft** is the official partner server! It's always up to date with the latest experimental features and new dungeons. Great community, check it out!

eternaltd.matecraft.org
